notes: Nieuwpoortkade 2 (1939; buurt Bedrijventerrein Landlust): a works and office complex in buff brick on the bank south of the Haarlemmerweg, east of De Bloem windmill, with a later office tower rising from its middle.

North front (w02-359, 2017-04-21, 0.6 deg; 2024-11-21 crop dropped for foliage): two storeys, a row of 16 wide white-framed windows upstairs; the ground storey has windows on the west half and a glazed recessed corner on the east; white-brick lettering 'da vinci creatieve ruimtes' across the west half (not modelled: a tenant sign).
East wings on the Nieuwpoortkade (w04-89 2021-03-22 sunlit, w05-89 2025-09-26): three storeys of wide white-framed windows, a glass-block stair column and two small balconies on the north wing.
South side (w03-179, 2018-06-20): a grey panel-clad band of two storeys with ribbon windows over a buff brick plinth with dark piers; the tower above it is buff brick with ribbon windows.
West (w01-269, 2022-05-02): the low works hall in brick with small high windows and blue doors, and a two-storey grey-clad office with a ribbon window over blue works doors.

Colour: two bricks. The north wing on the Nieuwpoortkade (walls[1]) is buff/yellow brick: #b29e7e from the sunlit w04-89 (2021-03-22; the 2022 crop w04-89b in full sun reads #f7d6a8, the shade crops darker, so the photos bracket it). The north front, south wing, south plinth and west hall are brown brick (dHue 6-12 against the buff, not shade of it): the brightest reading, #67594a (w02-359 2017, normalised), for all of them, left unmeasured so the export lifts it like any shaded wall. Grey cladding #8d918b is the shade reading of w03-179/w01-269, unmeasured. The tower reads light tan in w01-269/w03-179 and takes the buff.

Tower: no archived crop matches its panels (they stand inside the footprint, so all-walls.ts has no exposed BAG wall for them); ribbon windows in buff brick from the w01-269 and w03-179 views, inferred, not a street-facing group.
